procedure: Bind eligible evidence, reconciled results and domain analysis.
Separate result, attributed explanation and inferred mechanism.
Test alternatives and assign supported conclusion strength.
Return scoped findings, conditions and targeted research/analysis gaps.

acceptance.expectation: Finding IDs link question IDs, current source/observation/metric records, domain result paths and actual review coverage.
Reported or calculated results are distinguished from management explanations and analyst inference; contrary evidence and dependency limits are weighed.
Disposition and headline strength follow calibration, alternatives and uncertainty, preserving factual/fictional board mode and unresolved material reversibility.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction
